_README: English extraction registry for nf_ind_as_en. name_ru provides Russian display labels for output tables; aliases, descriptions and hints stay English for the English source documents.

extractable.description: Text flag indicating whether the independent auditor issued a modified opinion for the current reporting period.
extractable.hint: Use the Independent Auditor’s Report. Return 0 for an unmodified opinion and 1 for a qualified, adverse or disclaimer opinion. Do not create comparative periods unless a separate auditor’s opinion is disclosed for them.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Borrowings and debt obligations due after more than twelve months.
extractable.hint: Use the Balance Sheet, non-current liabilities, and notes to borrowings. Prefer non-current borrowings or long-term debt. Do not include current borrowings or lease liabilities if they are separately disclosed.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Lease liabilities due after more than twelve months under Ind AS 116.
extractable.hint: Use the Balance Sheet or lease note. Take only the non-current lease liability balance. Do not use right-of-use assets or lease payment cash flows.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.name_en: Short-term borrowings and current portion of long-term debt
aliases_en: Short-term borrowings and current portion of long-term debt
extractable.description: Borrowings due within twelve months, including current maturities of long-term borrowings where presented together.
extractable.hint: Use the Balance Sheet, current liabilities, and notes to borrowings. Include current maturities if the line is presented as current borrowings or current portion of borrowings. Exclude current lease liabilities if separately disclosed.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Current portion of lease liabilities due within twelve months under Ind AS 116.
extractable.hint: Use the Balance Sheet or lease note. Take only the current portion of lease liabilities. Do not use right-of-use assets or total lease liabilities unless current/non-current split is unavailable.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

aliases_en: cash and cash equivalents at end of period
extractable.description: Cash on hand, bank balances and short-term highly liquid investments classified as cash and cash equivalents.
extractable.hint: Use the Balance Sheet or the closing cash and cash equivalents line in the Cash Flow Statement. Return explicitly disclosed closing dates, including comparative dates. Do not include term deposits or securities unless classified as cash equivalents.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Term or fixed deposits placed with banks that are not classified as cash equivalents.
extractable.hint: Use notes to cash, bank balances or current financial assets. Take bank deposits or fixed deposits not classified as cash equivalents. Do not include ordinary cash and bank balances already included in CASH_EQUIVALENTS.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Perpetual bonds or similar perpetual instruments disclosed in equity or borrowings depending on classification.
extractable.hint: Use equity or borrowings notes. Extract only explicitly perpetual bonds or similar perpetual instruments. Do not use ordinary bonds or redeemable debentures.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Amounts payable to suppliers and other trade creditors, normally presented as trade payables.
extractable.hint: Use the Balance Sheet line trade payables or accounts payable. In Schedule III, check the trade payables note. Do not include borrowings, provisions or other financial liabilities unless the line is a combined trade and other payables total.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Amounts receivable from customers for goods or services, normally net of loss allowance.
extractable.hint: Use the Balance Sheet line trade receivables or accounts receivable, net. In Schedule III, check the trade receivables note. Exclude advances, prepaid expenses and tax receivables if separately disclosed.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Raw materials, work-in-progress, finished goods, traded goods and other inventories held for sale or production.
extractable.hint: Use the Balance Sheet current assets line inventories and the inventories note. Include raw materials, WIP, finished goods, traded goods and stores/spares if part of the inventory total.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Total assets expected to be realised, sold or consumed within the operating cycle or within twelve months.
extractable.hint: Use the Balance Sheet subtotal for total current assets under Schedule III Division II. Do not calculate from components if a subtotal is printed.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Total obligations expected to be settled within the operating cycle or within twelve months.
extractable.hint: Use the Balance Sheet subtotal for total current liabilities under Schedule III Division II. Do not calculate from components if a subtotal is printed.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Total carrying amount of all assets at the reporting date.
extractable.hint: Use the Balance Sheet final total assets line. It should equal total equity and liabilities.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Carrying amount of property, plant and equipment excluding right-of-use assets if separately disclosed.
extractable.hint: Use the Balance Sheet or property, plant and equipment note. Take carrying amount/net block. Exclude right-of-use assets, intangible assets and goodwill if separately disclosed.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Deferred tax assets arising from deductible temporary differences, tax losses or tax credits.
extractable.hint: Use the Balance Sheet or tax note. Extract deferred tax assets. Do not net against deferred tax liabilities unless the statement presents only a net balance.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Deferred tax liabilities arising from taxable temporary differences.
extractable.hint: Use the Balance Sheet or tax note. Extract deferred tax liabilities. Do not net against deferred tax assets unless the statement presents only a net balance.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Identifiable non-monetary assets without physical substance, excluding goodwill if presented separately.
extractable.hint: Use the Balance Sheet or intangible assets note. Exclude goodwill if separately disclosed and exclude right-of-use assets.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Goodwill recognised on acquisition of subsidiaries or businesses.
extractable.hint: Use the Balance Sheet or business combinations/goodwill note. Extract goodwill carrying amount only, not total intangible assets.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

aliases_en: total equity attributable to owners and non-controlling interests
extractable.description: Total equity attributable to owners and non-controlling interests.
extractable.hint: Use the Balance Sheet total equity line. Include equity attributable to owners and non-controlling interests where consolidated statements are used.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Carrying amount of assets representing the right to use leased underlying assets under Ind AS 116.
extractable.hint: Use the Balance Sheet or lease note under Ind AS 116. Extract right-of-use assets only. Do not use lease liabilities or ordinary PPE unless ROU assets are embedded and no separate split is provided.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Revenue from ordinary activities, normally presented as revenue from operations for Indian companies.
extractable.hint: Use the Statement of Profit and Loss. In India, prefer the Schedule III label revenue from operations. For segment revenue, prefer revenue from external customers and exclude inter-segment revenue if separately disclosed.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

aliases_en: earnings before finance costs and tax
profit before finance costs and tax
extractable.description: Profit from operations before finance income, finance costs and tax.
extractable.hint: Use the statutory Statement of Profit and Loss. Prefer an explicit operating profit/profit from operations subtotal before finance income, finance costs and tax. If the statutory P&L does not print operating profit/profit from operations, use the consolidated segment result/profit TOTAL before finance costs and tax. Do not use EBITDA, profit before tax or adjusted management metrics.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

aliases_en: changes in inventories of finished goods work-in-progress and stock-in-trade
extractable.description: Direct costs of goods or services sold, or the closest cost-of-sales subtotal disclosed by the entity.
extractable.hint: Use the Statement of Profit and Loss and cost notes. Prefer cost of sales/cost of revenue if disclosed. For Schedule III presentation, use direct cost lines such as cost of materials consumed, purchases of stock-in-trade and changes in inventories only when they form the cost-of-sales block.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Profit or loss for the period after tax before attribution to owners and non-controlling interests.
extractable.hint: Use the Statement of Profit and Loss. Take profit for the period/year after tax before attribution to owners and non-controlling interests. Losses should remain negative.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Profit or loss before tax.
extractable.hint: Use the Statement of Profit and Loss. Take profit before tax/PBT immediately before tax expense. Losses should remain negative.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Borrowing costs capitalised into qualifying assets during the period.
extractable.hint: Use borrowings, finance costs or PPE/CWIP notes. Extract borrowing costs capitalised during the period. Do not use cash interest paid or total finance costs.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Revenue less cost of sales or equivalent direct costs.
extractable.hint: Use the Statement of Profit and Loss. Take explicit gross profit if printed. If it is not printed, derive it from the direct-cost block: revenue from operations less cost of materials consumed, purchases of stock-in-trade, changes in inventories and similar direct service/product costs. Do not derive it from operating profit or profit before tax.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Operating expenses other than cost of sales, such as employee benefits, selling, administrative and other operating expenses.
extractable.hint: Use the Statement of Profit and Loss. If no single operating expenses line exists, sum relevant operating expense lines between gross profit and operating profit. Exclude finance costs, tax and cost of sales.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Depreciation and amortisation expense for property, plant and equipment and intangible assets during the period.
extractable.hint: Use the Statement of Profit and Loss, cash flow adjustments, or notes. Include depreciation and amortisation. Do not include impairment losses unless the source combines them in the same printed line.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

aliases_en: payments for property plant and equipment
purchase of property plant and equipment and intangible assets
extractable.description: Capital expenditure for property, plant and equipment and intangible assets, as disclosed or derived from investing cash flows.
extractable.hint: Use the primary Cash Flow Statement investing section. Prefer the signed cash outflow for purchases/payments for PPE and intangible assets; preserve parentheses or minus signs. Use an MD&A capex total only if no cash-flow row is available, and do not replace a signed cash-flow row with a positive note total.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Cash paid for interest during the period.
extractable.hint: Use the Cash Flow Statement. Extract cash interest paid. Do not use finance costs from the Statement of Profit and Loss unless the cash flow amount is unavailable and the source clearly equates them.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Cash received as interest during the period.
extractable.hint: Use the Cash Flow Statement. Extract cash interest received. Do not use finance income unless the cash flow amount is unavailable and the source clearly equates them.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

aliases_en: dividends to owners of the parent
extractable.description: Cash dividends paid to shareholders of the parent company.
extractable.hint: Use the primary Cash Flow Statement financing section first; statement of changes in equity is fallback only. Extract dividends paid to owners/shareholders of the parent and preserve the signed cash outflow, including parentheses or minus signs. Do not use dividend declared/proposed amounts unless they equal the cash paid line.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Cash dividends paid to holders of non-controlling interests.
extractable.hint: Use the primary Cash Flow Statement financing section. Extract dividends paid to non-controlling interests separately from parent shareholder dividends and preserve the signed cash outflow, including parentheses or minus signs.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Total cash dividends paid by the group during the period.
extractable.hint: Use the primary Cash Flow Statement financing section. Extract total cash dividends paid and preserve the signed cash outflow, including parentheses or minus signs. If dividends to owners and NCI are separately disclosed, sum only those dividend cash outflow lines. Do not use dividend declared/proposed amounts unless they equal the cash paid line.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Cash outflow for repurchase or buyback of the entity’s own shares.
extractable.hint: Use the Cash Flow Statement financing section or equity note. Extract cash outflow for buyback/repurchase of shares. Do not use the treasury share balance.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

aliases_en: net cash generated from operating activities
extractable.description: Net cash generated from or used in operating activities.
extractable.hint: Use the Cash Flow Statement subtotal for net cash generated from or used in operating activities. Do not calculate if a subtotal is printed.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.name_ru: Приобретение дочерних организаций (обществ) за вычетом (минусом) денежных средств и за вычетом (минусом) полученных денежных средств
aliases_en: purchase of subsidiaries net of cash acquired
extractable.description: Cash outflow for acquisition of subsidiaries or businesses, normally net of cash acquired.
extractable.hint: Use the Cash Flow Statement investing section. Take acquisition of subsidiaries/businesses net of cash acquired. Do not include purchases of associates unless the line explicitly combines business acquisitions.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.name_ru: Вложения в ассоциированные организации (общества) и совместные предприятия
aliases_en: investments accounted for using the equity method
extractable.description: Carrying amount of investments in associates or joint ventures.
extractable.hint: Use the Balance Sheet non-current investments note. Extract investments in associates or joint ventures carried under the equity method. If the carrying value is disclosed only in a note and in a foreign currency (for example EUR million), extract that value with the source currency/unit unchanged. Do not use share of profit or dividends received.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.name_en: Proceeds from disposal of group companies
aliases_en: Proceeds from disposal of group companies
sale of investments in subsidiaries or associates
extractable.description: Cash proceeds from disposal of subsidiaries, associates, joint ventures or other group companies.
extractable.hint: Use the Cash Flow Statement investing section. Extract cash proceeds from disposal of subsidiaries, associates, joint ventures or group companies. Do not use equity-accounted profit or the carrying amount of investments.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

aliases_en: purchase of property plant and equipment
payments for property plant and equipment
extractable.description: Cash outflow for purchase of property, plant and equipment.
extractable.hint: Use the Cash Flow Statement investing section. Extract purchases/payments for property, plant and equipment. If PPE and intangibles are combined in one line, leave this metric null and use COMBINED_ASSET_PURCHASES.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Cash outflow for purchase of intangible assets.
extractable.hint: Use the Cash Flow Statement investing section. Extract purchases/payments for intangible assets. If intangibles are combined with PPE in one line, leave this metric null and use COMBINED_ASSET_PURCHASES.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.name_ru: Приобретение основных средств и нематериальных активов
extractable.name_en: Fixed asset and intangible asset purchases
aliases_en: Fixed asset and intangible asset purchases
purchase of property plant and equipment and intangible assets
capital expenditure on tangible and intangible assets
extractable.description: Combined cash outflow for purchase of property, plant and equipment and intangible assets where not split.
extractable.hint: Use only when the Cash Flow Statement presents one combined line for purchase of PPE and intangible/fixed assets. Do not duplicate separate PPE and intangible purchase lines.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.name_ru: Поступления от продажи основных средств и нематериальных активов
extractable.name_en: Proceeds from disposal of PPE and Intangible assets
aliases_en: Proceeds from disposal of PPE and Intangible assets
proceeds from sale of property plant and equipment
proceeds from disposal of fixed assets
proceeds from sale of intangible assets
extractable.description: Cash proceeds from disposal of property, plant and equipment and intangible assets.
extractable.hint: Use the Cash Flow Statement investing section. Extract proceeds from disposal of PPE and intangible assets. Include both if separately disclosed and the metric is intended as a combined total.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Finance income such as interest income and other financial income.
extractable.hint: Use the Statement of Profit and Loss or finance-income note. Extract finance income / interest income only. Do not use total other income, other operating income, fair value gains, foreign exchange gains, gain on sale of investments, or cash interest received unless the finance-income note explicitly includes them.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Finance costs such as interest expense and other borrowing costs.
extractable.hint: Use the Statement of Profit and Loss. Extract finance costs/finance expenses. Preserve source sign conventions for expense lines.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.name_en: Repayment of principal portion of lease liabilities
aliases_en: Repayment of principal portion of lease liabilities
extractable.description: Principal portion of lease payments classified as financing cash flows.
extractable.hint: Use the primary Cash Flow Statement financing section first. Extract the signed cash outflow for principal portion of lease payments only and preserve parentheses or minus signs. Do not include lease interest paid and do not replace the cash-flow row with a positive lease-note total.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

aliases_en: adjustments to reconcile profit to cash flows
extractable.description: Subtotal or sum of non-cash and other adjustments in the indirect operating cash flow reconciliation before working capital movements.
extractable.hint: Use the indirect Cash Flow Statement. Extract the subtotal of adjustments before working capital movements if printed; otherwise sum only the adjustment block. Exclude working capital movements, tax, interest and investing/financing cash flows.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

aliases_en: changes in operating assets and liabilities
extractable.description: Subtotal or sum of changes in working capital or operating assets and liabilities in operating cash flow.
extractable.hint: Use the indirect Cash Flow Statement. Extract the subtotal of working capital changes if printed and preserve its sign. If no subtotal is printed, sum only inventory, receivable, payable and other operating working-capital movement lines. Exclude non-cash adjustments, interest, tax and investing/financing cash flows.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.name_ru: Прибыль до вычета процентов, налогов, износа и амортизации
aliases_en: earnings before interest tax depreciation and amortisation
extractable.description: Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation, when explicitly disclosed.
extractable.hint: Use segment reporting, MD&A, key metrics or reconciliations. Extract only explicitly disclosed EBITDA/OIBDA. Do not calculate from operating profit and D&A unless this metric is being handled as calculated.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Guarantees, financial guarantees or similar off-balance sheet commitments issued by the entity.
extractable.hint: Use commitments and contingent liabilities notes. Extract guarantees or financial guarantees issued. Do not include general legal claims unless included in the guarantees line.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Committed but undrawn borrowing facilities available to the entity.
extractable.hint: Use liquidity risk, borrowings or capital management notes. Extract undrawn committed facilities or available credit lines, preserving unit and scale exactly as disclosed in narrative text.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.name_ru: Обязательства будущих периодов по капитальным затратам
extractable.description: Contracted capital expenditure commitments not yet recognised as liabilities.
extractable.hint: Use commitments notes. Extract capital commitments or contractual commitments for capital expenditure not provided for. Do not include routine purchase commitments unless they are capital in nature.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.name_ru: Резерв под ожидаемые кредитные убытки (дебиторская задолженность)
aliases_en: expected credit loss allowance on receivables
extractable.description: Loss allowance or allowance for doubtful accounts related to trade receivables.
extractable.hint: Use the trade receivables or financial instruments note. Extract loss allowance/ECL allowance for trade receivables or doubtful debts. Do not use bad debt expense unless the metric requested is a flow.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.name_ru: Расход по текущему налогу на прибыль
extractable.description: Current income tax expense for the period, excluding deferred tax unless explicitly presented together as current tax.
extractable.hint: Use the Statement of Profit and Loss or tax note. Extract current tax expense. Do not replace it with total tax expense if current and deferred tax are separately available.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.name_en: Investment securities and other financial assets
aliases_en: Investment securities and other financial assets
extractable.description: Debt or equity investments and securities held as financial assets.
extractable.hint: Use the Balance Sheet and financial assets/investments notes. Extract securities or investment financial assets. Do not include cash equivalents, bank deposits or investments in associates if separately classified.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.name_ru: Инвестиции в ассоциированные и совместные предприятия
aliases_en: investments in associates and joint ventures
investments accounted for using the equity method
extractable.description: Total investments in associates and joint ventures accounted for using the equity method.
extractable.hint: Use the Balance Sheet or investments note. Extract total investments in associates and joint ventures. If the carrying value is disclosed only in a note and in a foreign currency (for example EUR million), extract that value with the source currency/unit unchanged. Do not use purchases in cash flow or share of profit in P&L.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

aliases_en: financial liabilities at fair value through profit or loss
extractable.description: Financial liabilities classified as trading, fair value through profit or loss, derivative or similar instrument liabilities.
extractable.hint: Use the Balance Sheet and financial instruments notes. Extract trading/FVTPL/derivative financial liabilities where separately disclosed. Do not use ordinary borrowings or issued debt unless explicitly classified as securities liabilities.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.name_ru: Амортизация активов в форме права пользования
extractable.description: Depreciation charge on right-of-use assets for the period.
extractable.hint: Use the lease note or depreciation note. Extract depreciation or amortisation of right-of-use assets only. Do not use total depreciation and amortisation.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Cash interest or finance cost component of lease payments.
extractable.hint: Use the Cash Flow Statement or lease note. Extract interest paid on lease liabilities or finance cost on lease liabilities. Do not include principal repayment.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

aliases_en: issued subscribed and paid-up share capital
extractable.description: Nominal value of issued and paid-up share capital.
extractable.hint: Use the Balance Sheet or equity note. Extract issued/subscribed/paid-up share capital at the reporting date. Do not use total equity.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Securities premium or share premium reserve.
extractable.hint: Use the equity note or statement of changes in equity. Extract securities premium/share premium. Do not use share capital or retained earnings.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

aliases_en: surplus in statement of profit and loss
extractable.description: Accumulated retained earnings, surplus or deficit at the reporting date.
extractable.hint: Use the equity section or statement of changes in equity. Extract retained earnings/surplus/accumulated deficit at the reporting date. Do not use profit for the period.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Equity in subsidiaries not attributable to owners of the parent.
extractable.hint: Use the Balance Sheet equity section. Extract non-controlling interests, which may be positive or negative.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Fair value of derivative financial liabilities.
extractable.hint: Use the Balance Sheet or financial instruments note. Extract derivative financial liabilities measured at fair value. Do not net against derivative assets unless only a net liability is presented.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Insurance contract liabilities, only for entities with insurance operations.
extractable.hint: Use only if the entity has insurance operations. Extract insurance contract liabilities. Otherwise return null.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Insurance revenue or insurance service income, only for entities with insurance operations.
extractable.hint: Use only if the entity has insurance operations. Extract insurance revenue/service income. Otherwise return null.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Insurance service expense or claims expense, only for entities with insurance operations.
extractable.hint: Use only if the entity has insurance operations. Extract insurance service expense or claims expense. Otherwise return null.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

aliases_en: provision for litigation and other obligations
extractable.description: Net creation or reversal of other provisions or reserves, excluding tax and financial asset impairment unless explicitly included.
extractable.hint: Use provisions or contingencies notes and P&L if a net provision creation/reversal line is disclosed. Exclude tax, ECL on receivables and finance costs unless explicitly included in the same printed line.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Basic earnings per ordinary share for the period.
extractable.hint: Use the Statement of Profit and Loss. Extract basic earnings per share, not diluted EPS. Unit is currency per share, not the general table scale.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Cash dividends received from associates, joint ventures or other investments.
extractable.hint: Use the Cash Flow Statement investing section. Extract cash dividends received from investments, associates or joint ventures. Do not use dividend income accrued in P&L.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Gross value of transactions processed through a platform during the period, before deductions.
extractable.hint: Extract only directly reported actual GTV for a completed period. Do not substitute GMV, TPV or revenue; exclude guidance, targets and estimates.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Number of orders during the period under the issuer's reported definition.
extractable.hint: Extract only the reported actual order count for a completed period. Do not calculate it or use forecasts or targets.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Total monetary volume of payments processed by the company during the period.
extractable.hint: Extract only directly reported actual TPV. Do not substitute GTV, GMV or revenue; exclude guidance, targets and estimates.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Gross value of goods or services sold through a platform during the period.
extractable.hint: Extract only directly reported actual GMV. Do not substitute GTV, TPV or revenue; exclude guidance, targets and estimates.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Issuer-reported number of users active during a month.
extractable.hint: Extract actual MAU for the stated period; do not substitute DAU or registered users. Exclude forecasts and targets.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Issuer-reported number of users active during a day.
extractable.hint: Extract actual DAU for the stated period; do not substitute MAU or registered users. Exclude forecasts and targets.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Number of paid subscriptions or paying subscribers at the reporting date.
extractable.hint: Extract only the directly reported actual count. Do not use subscription revenue, free users, guidance or targets.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Share of available capacity or resources actually used during the period.
extractable.hint: Extract only the reported actual percentage and retain the issuer's definition. Do not derive it from capacity figures or use targets.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Reported balance of order backlog or remaining performance obligations at the reporting date.

extractable.description: Issuer-reported annualized run rate of recurring revenue at the reporting date.
extractable.hint: Extract only directly reported actual ARR at a date. Do not annualize quarterly revenue yourself or use guidance or targets.

extractable.description: Number of paid user seats or licenses at the reporting date.
extractable.hint: Extract only the directly reported actual paid-seat count. Do not substitute all users, revenue or forecasts.

extractable.description: Average revenue per user or customer during the period.
extractable.hint: Extract only directly reported actual ARPU with its source currency and period. Do not derive it from revenue and users or use forecasts.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Reported share of platform revenue or fees in gross transaction volume during the period.
extractable.hint: Extract only directly reported actual take rate as a percentage. Do not derive it from revenue and GMV/GTV or use targets.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Gross value of bookings or orders made through a platform during the period before deductions.
extractable.hint: Extract only directly reported actual Gross Bookings. Do not substitute revenue or GMV/GTV, and exclude guidance and estimates.
extractable.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

extractable.description: Number of trips or rides completed during the period.
extractable.hint: Extract only the reported actual trip count for a completed period. Do not substitute orders or use forecasts or targets.
